jurisdiction: General assessment; used in IAAO ratio studies
summary: Ratio-study vertical-equity statistic estimating whether assessment ratios systematically change as property values change.
plain_language: PRB checks whether higher-value properties tend to be assessed at lower or higher percentages than lower-value properties.

relationships.note: Negative or positive patterns may indicate regressivity/progressivity depending on ratio orientation.
PRD is a descriptive ratio of means; PRB is regression-oriented.

source_refs.citation: IAAO, Glossary for Property Appraisal and Assessment.
